item.title: Krewe of Centaur parade launches Shreveport's Mardi Gras fun
item.description: The Krewe of Centaur Mardi Gras Parade brought big crowds, big smiles, and plenty of beads to downtown Shreveport, creating a memorable celebration for all.

item.title: Man arrested on multiple arson charges following Shreveport house fire
item.description: Brandon J. Davis was arrested and charged with arson and criminal trespass after a fire broke out at a Shreveport home, which spread to the occupied neighbor's house.

item.title: Federal court rules Louisiana can enforce restrictions on drug prices
item.description: A federal court has ruled against several large drug companies in their effort to strike down a state law that limits drug prices to low-income and other healthcare providers.

item.title: 'I have no regrets': Lindsey Vonn speaks out after scary crash at Winter Olympics
item.description: "I tried. I dreamt. I jumped," she wrote on Monday.

item.title: Caddo Parish Sheriff's Office launches new disability decal program to aid emergency response
item.description: The Caddo Parish Sheriff's Office has launched a new initiative, "Friends of the Community," to provide a Voluntary Disability Decal to individuals with special needs, which will alert first responders to their needs during emergencies.

item.title: Caddo Parish sheriff launches "Stop with the Excuses" program to support parents of At-Risk Youth
item.description: The Caddo Parish Sheriff's Office is launching the "Stop With the Excuses" program to provide parents and guardians of at-risk youth with practical guidance on how to prevent risky behaviors and promote positive parental involvement.
